How the graph is organised

Three layers. Profile: what each district has (soils, crops). Rules: what the official contingency plan says to do under each condition. History: what actually happened in every season from 2000 to 2025, and the yield that followed.

District --GROWS--> Crop --APPLIES_TO_CROP--+ | v | Condition <-SUBTYPE_OF- ConditionDetail --RECOMMENDS--> Action --SUGGESTS_CROP--> Crop | ^ +-HAS_SEASON_RECORD-> SeasonRecord --EXPERIENCED +--HAD_YIELD--> Crop

Example: Beed, Soybean, dry spell at flowering → start at ConditionDetail mid_dry_spell_flowering, follow RECOMMENDS edges where district = Beed and crop = Soybean to get the actions and PDF pages; SUGGESTS_CROP gives alternatives; EXPERIENCED (backwards) gives the past Beed seasons with the same dry spell, and HAD_YIELD their soybean yield.
